title: Exact Rényi-2 total correlation of Gaussian magnitudes
limitations: The theorem is stated for positive-definite correlation matrices; singular Gaussian laws require a separate support-level formulation.
The exact determinant expression has exponentially many sign terms in general.
No arbitrary-order Renyi analogue or polynomial-time high-dimensional evaluation method is claimed.
Generic Gaussian-mixture L2 or chi-square-divergence literature remains the principal residual originality risk for an equivalent specialization.

artifacts.purpose: Deterministic evaluation of the exact determinant formula, bivariate identity, local expansion, and equicorrelation threshold.
